findings.summary: The matcher misses auth failures where the CLI exits with no result event
findings.evidence: claude.rs:438 builds the detail `exited without a result: {stderr_tail}` when no result event arrived. Splitting at the first ': ' makes the text a stderr *tail*, which need not start with a fixed phrase, so an expired login that ends this way keeps the old behaviour. The plan's open question covers only the result-text form. Fix: State this path in the CHANGELOG or the docs as a known miss. The cleaner fix is the follow-up the plan already names: a typed stop cause on AgentOutput, set in athena-agent from is_error and subtype, which replaces text matching for both paths.

findings.summary: Repeated environment stops now have no pause bound at all
findings.evidence: counted() already drops environment stops from T1, T4 and T5. With the `kept` rule gone, T3 drops them too. A line that runs the producer in full and then stops on low disk or check timeout on every retry is never paused, only flagged once it passes T3_LINE_DOLLARS (scope_guard.rs:306). The introspections asked for this, and the plan names the risk. Fix: Keep the change. Make sure the facts() text and the docs say plainly that the dollar flag is the only bound on environment loops, so the person running Athena knows to watch for it. Consider proposing a separate count of environment stops per line as a follow-up.

findings.summary: Part of the failure class stays open: a verifier 401 still counts as a rejection
findings.evidence: Introspection 20261029-195138-3pqb lists a 'real critic or verifier failure' among the stop reasons to tell apart. The plan leaves the verifier path (verification.rs into verify.rs:307, closed Rejected) as a named follow-up. Its reason holds: that path needs a new close-and-resume route, and verify.rs is excluded for the replay work. Fix: Keep the follow-up in the CHANGELOG and the scope-guard doc, as planned. In the change description, say the class is closed for the planner, critic and producer but not yet for the verifier, so criterion 1 does not overstate the fix.

findings.summary: line_pause returns the stored mark's text even when a different signal now drives the pause
findings.evidence: line_pause returns the file's mark whenever the recompute is at Level::Pause. If the stored pause was T3 and only T4 fires under the current rules, the refusal shows T3 text and T3 lift advice. Fix: When the recomputed pause signals differ from the stored mark's signals, rewrite the mark from the recompute, or build the refusal from the recomputed facts.

summary: I checked the plan against the snapshot, and its claims hold. attempt_of (scope_guard.rs:525-530) marks a stop as environment only when the closing reason starts with ENVIRONMENT_PREFIX. line_pause (scope_guard.rs:728-735) returns the stored pause file without checking it. try_watch_line removes only the flag file when no signal fires (lines 796-798). t3_basis has the `kept` rule (lines 273-282). is_environment_reason accepts only LOW_DISK and CHECK_TIMEOUT (disk.rs:248). The 'did not complete' reasons are written at producer.rs:206 and at planning.rs:186 and 332, and stop_planning adds the planning prefix (planning.rs:11). line_pause has two callers, go (run/mod.rs:696) and retry (reading.rs:1036). claude.rs:272 builds the agent detail as `<subtype>: <text>`. The fix is made where the fault starts: one classifier, every site that writes a failed-job reason goes through one builder, and the pause is recomputed on each check. The narrow resume check keeps auth and usage stops from being resumed. Each behaviour demonstration drives production entry points (go, retry, line_pause, request_records) with the existing scripted fake, and each would fail on the base commit. Athena's two out-of-deliverable findings (planning.rs, run/tests.rs) are justified: planning.rs is the only place the planner and critic reasons are written. My remaining concerns are minor. The auth and usage detection is a text match. It misses CLI failures that end with no result event. All environment spend now leaves T3, so a line that keeps stopping on the environment has no pause, only the dollar flag. The verifier 401 stays open as a named follow-up. None of these blocks the plan.
